title: Scripture and Discipleship
definition: Scripture and discipleship belong together because disciples of Jesus are formed, corrected, equipped, and sent by the Word of God.
summary: The Christian life is not shaped by feelings, trends, or human wisdom first, but by the teaching of Christ and the whole counsel of God. Scripture trains disciples to know Christ, follow Him, serve others, resist error, and live on mission.
christFocus: Jesus commanded His followers to make disciples by baptizing and teaching obedience to all He commanded. Scripture gives the church the truth of Christ and the pattern for faithful discipleship.

studySections.heading: Disciples Abide in the Word
studySections.content: Jesus said that those who abide in His word are truly His disciples. Discipleship requires ongoing submission to the teaching of Christ.

studySections.heading: The Word Forms the Church
studySections.content: The early church devoted itself to the apostles' teaching. A healthy church is built around Scripture, fellowship, prayer, worship, and mission.

studySections.heading: Scripture Equips for Ministry
studySections.content: The Word prepares believers for every good work. It equips pastors, teachers, parents, servants, and all believers for faithful service.

studySections.heading: Teaching Others to Obey
studySections.content: Discipleship is not only learning truth; it is helping others follow Jesus. Scripture must be taught with clarity, patience, love, and a call to faithful obedience.
